_doc: Lanternroot's overworld pictures from ComfyUI (pipeline/pixel/README.md, ADR-0061): `scripts/pixel.sh --comfy 'ow-*'`. Every asset has a fixed seed and selected candidate; the pixel build validates ids, output paths, picks and raw_from dependencies. Results lock to pipeline/pixel/palette.json. Buildings, landmarks, trees and larger props come from here; 16-pixel characters, small props and ground tiles do not. A raw_from sibling reuses a prior asset's cached candidates, and must follow its source in this list. The Root Gate's generated silhouette receives a deterministic closed-face overlay in landmarks.py so it remains sealed until its story reveal.
